meta.title: GPU image work is live. Most of the rest waited on shared files and on you.
meta.lede: The 16-hour window ended when its allowance ran out. One workstream landed with a measured win, four measurements came back, and seven workstreams are parked until tomorrow. The next commission starts with residency and the host sentinel, and applies your feedback below.
